lead_with.title: Markets operations in New York hours
lead_with.text: ANZ's markets operations run from Asia hubs (Singapore, Mumbai). A Montreal team could cover the **Americas trading day** for settlements, confirmations and FX operations. A Finance Montréal-commissioned Boyd study puts a 150-person financial operation at about **US$18.9M a year in Montreal vs US$35.3M in New York**, in the New York time zone.

lead_with.title: The IFC credit fits his work
lead_with.text: Quebec's **International Financial Centre** credit can reach **C$18,000 per eligible employee per year**, including for services provided under contract to a **foreign affiliate** (compliance, data, IT, fund and transaction support). Eligibility is checked case by case. **Settlement, clearing and middle-office** work is squarely in scope.

lead_with.title: Peers already there
lead_with.text: **Morgan Stanley, BNP Paribas, Société Générale, Crédit Agricole** and **State Street** run operations in Montreal, alongside **120,000+ finance and insurance** and **150,000+ tech** professionals.

person.name: Anup Singh
person.text: Based in **Singapore**. Since **Nov 2024**: Global Business Change Lead and Head of SEA Operations, Markets Operations, Global Markets at ANZ (Streak title: Head of Markets Critical Operations Change & SEA Operations). At ANZ since **2008**: Associate Director, Global FX Operations and SEA Operations Lead (2019-2024); Senior Product Manager, Fixed Income & Repo (2017-2019); Head of Markets Static Data and Settlement Operations (2015-2017); earlier settlement and trade control roles, including **building the Mumbai markets operations branch**. Before ANZ: Deutsche Bank operations (derivative settlements). PGDM in Finance (IBMR) and B.Sc. Physics & Mathematics (DDU Gorakhpur). Career details from a public profile aggregator: **to be confirmed** on LinkedIn.

company.text: ANZ Group (ASX: ANZ) serves retail, commercial and institutional clients in Australia, New Zealand and about 30 markets. CEO **Nuno Matos** is resetting the bank to cut duplication and simplify; he says **Institutional and New Zealand** continue to perform well. Singapore is the hub for South East Asia, India and the Middle East. In the US, ANZ's New York team supports trade and investment flows with Asia-Pacific. Canada is not visible in ANZ's public footprint (to be confirmed).

financials.text: **1H26** (half to Mar 31, 2026; released May 1, 2026): statutory profit **A$3.65bn**, cash profit **A$3.78bn** (+70% vs 2H25; +14% excluding 2H25 significant items). Cash RoTE **11.6%**, cost-to-income **49.4%**, **CET1 12.39%**, interim dividend **83 cents**. FY2026 results are due in **November 2026** (date to be confirmed): check them before the meeting.

industry.title: Banks are simplifying operations
industry.text: ANZ's reset aims to reduce duplication. Consolidating and relocating operations to skilled, lower-cost hubs is a standard lever, and Anup leads change in that area.

industry.title: Follow-the-sun markets operations
industry.text: Global markets desks need operations coverage across Asia, Europe and the Americas; a North American time zone hub closes the gap.

industry.title: Financial-centre competition
industry.text: Montreal competes with Toronto, New York and US nearshore cities using **cost**, **tax credits**, **bilingual talent** and **AI research**.
